## 1. Company Overview

**Upnex It** (বাংলা: আপনেক্স আইটি; also written as Upnex IT, Upnexit, উপনেক্স আইটি)
is a professional software development and IT services company based in
Naogaon, Bangladesh. The company designs and builds custom software,
school management systems, hospital management systems (HMS), ERP/CRM,
e-commerce platforms, mobile applications, and modern websites for
businesses, educational institutions and healthcare providers across
Bangladesh.

Upnex It combines world-class engineering standards with deep
understanding of the local Bangladeshi market, the Bengali language,
and the workflows of schools, hospitals and small/medium businesses
in the region. Every project is delivered end-to-end — from
consultation and UX design to development, deployment, training and
long-term maintenance.

## 4. Services in Detail

### 4.1 Custom Software Development
Tailor-made software built around a business's specific workflows —
ERP, CRM, inventory and warehouse management, point-of-sale,
e-commerce platforms, billing systems, internal admin tools, and
industry-specific solutions. Delivered with full source code, training,
and post-launch support.

### 4.2 School Management Software
A complete digital platform for educational institutions:
- Student admissions, profiles and academic records
- Daily attendance (student + teacher)
- Examination, results and report cards
- Fee collection and online payments
- SMS / email notifications to parents
- Parent portal with grades and updates
- Teacher dashboard and timetable
- Library, transport, hostel modules
- Multi-class, multi-section, multi-session support
- Reports and analytics for administrators

### 4.3 Hospital Management Software (HMS)
For clinics, diagnostic centers and hospitals:
- Patient registration and history
- Appointment scheduling and queue
- Doctor and department management
- Electronic Medical Records (EMR)
- Pharmacy and inventory
- Lab and diagnostic integration
- Billing, insurance and invoicing
- Reports for administration and compliance

### 4.4 Web Development
Modern, mobile-responsive, SEO-optimized websites and web applications
built on current best practices. Includes business websites, landing
pages, blogs, e-commerce stores, custom dashboards and web portals.

### 4.5 Mobile App Development
Cross-platform Android and iOS applications for businesses, schools,
hospitals and consumer services.

### 4.6 ERP Software
Integrated enterprise resource planning systems for manufacturing,
retail, distribution and service businesses — including accounting,
HR, inventory, sales and procurement modules.

### 4.7 IT Consulting & Server Management
Cloud setup (AWS, Google Cloud, DigitalOcean, VPS), secure server
administration, domain and hosting management, technical consulting,
and digital transformation strategy.

## 5. Service Area

Upnex It serves clients across all of Bangladesh, with particularly
strong coverage in northern Bangladesh:

- Naogaon District: Naogaon Sadar, Atrai, Badalgachhi, Dhamoirhat,
  Manda, Mahadebpur, Niamatpur, Patnitala, Porsha, Raninagar, Sapahar
- Rajshahi Division (entire division)
- Major Bangladeshi cities: Dhaka, Chittagong, Rajshahi, Khulna,
  Sylhet, Barishal, Rangpur, Mymensingh
- International clients on request

## 6. Why Customers Choose Upnex It

- Bangladeshi engineering team — fluent in Bengali and English
- Affordable pricing tailored to the Bangladeshi market
- End-to-end project ownership (design → build → deploy → support)
- Secure cloud infrastructure and dedicated server management
- Proven track record with schools, hospitals and businesses
- Free initial consultation
- Long-term support and updates
- Local presence in Naogaon for on-site support when needed
